variables.name: UMBRACO_BASE_URL
variables.title: Site address
variables.description: The https address of your Umbraco site, for example https://www.example.com. Settings → Umbrella → Overview in the backoffice shows it.

variables.name: UMBRACO_CLIENT_ID
variables.title: Client id
variables.description: The client id of your API user, from its client credentials in the backoffice (for example, umbraco-back-office-mcp).

variables.name: UMBRACO_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.title: Client secret
variables.description: The client secret you saved when you added the API user's client credentials.

variables.name: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
variables.title: Check the site's HTTPS certificate
variables.description: Set to 1 to verify certificates, or 0 only for a local site using the ASP.NET Core development certificate.
